title: Alessandro Masullo&\#x27;s proposed GRH proof announced for expert review
summary: Ravi Vakil announced that Alessandro Masullo has a proposed proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis and that the current draft is being put out now rather than after further polishing. Vakil says Brian Conrad has examined it closely for months and provided extensive feedback that is being incorporated, and that the work is "so far looking good." He also states that the work is entirely human, with no AI. The announcement does not present a verified proof; it releases a draft for mathematicians to scrutinize.
